chapters.detail: This makes the product easier to navigate while keeping responsibilities explicit. Opening a project, changing its plan and carrying out its next task are related actions, but each needs the correct sources, identity and permissions.

chapters.title: The methods and tools behind this project.
chapters.body: The work combines business reasoning with practical methods and tools. Each capability here is tied to the project story you have just explored.
chapters.detail: I designed the workflow, source boundaries, review controls and continuity model, then directed AI-assisted implementation and verification. The current release covers 24 workflows, 295 typed actions and 103 retained tool/dependency assignments. The catalogue defines scope; actual readiness and execution remain operation-specific.

skills.label: Shared action routing across plugin surfaces
skills.description: The current implementation registry maps public actions to workflow owners; MCP enters the internal dispatcher and shared service instead of separately implementing lifecycle behavior.

skills.label: Authenticated MCP service architecture
skills.description: The server supports stdio and streamable HTTP. HTTP requires bearer or OAuth authentication even on loopback; OAuth audience must equal the exposed MCP resource.

skills.label: Bounded SDK contracts and replay handling
skills.description: The internal SDK checks invocation bindings, reported authority effects and payload bounds, with SQL request/response replay records and hash conflicts.

skills.label: Durable session lifecycle and attach cleanup
skills.description: Boot checks active-session, repository and pointer state. Resume binds a host session; an activation failure closes/releases the attempted session rather than certifying attachment.

skills.label: Host hook transport with visible failure receipts
skills.description: Prompt, pre-tool and stop handlers validate transport and bind host payloads, prepare/commit turn records, and emit explicit gap receipts when required control is unavailable.

skills.label: Capture coverage accounting
skills.description: Status computes required versus supported hook surfaces and marks per-input invocation unproven until a matching prepare receipt exists.

skills.label: Ordered source intake with frozen identities
skills.description: Local files, directory members and ZIP members are hashed; ordered source batches preserve occurrence identities and idempotency, and re-freeze detects stale inputs.

skills.label: Structured Word and workbook extraction
skills.description: DOCX paragraphs/headings/tables and XLSX workbook relationships, defined names, cells and formulas become source-located facts.

skills.label: Tabular and presentation format coverage
skills.description: Dedicated branches handle delimited data, JSON, Parquet, legacy Excel and PPTX, with parser-specific facts rather than one generic filename label.

skills.label: PDF, image and OCR fallback integration
skills.description: PDF extraction uses native metadata and page text/structure with optional fallbacks; image OCR tries RapidOCR then Tesseract and records empty/review-required states.

skills.label: Read-only external SQLite inspection
skills.description: SQLite/brain-loader intake opens immutable read-only connections, checks integrity and foreign keys, and inventories schemas, tables and relationships.

skills.label: Archive and project package boundary inspection
skills.description: Archive parsing records member names, sizes, CRC and path-safety flags, then emits brain-loader or project-engulf metadata without executing contents.

skills.label: Real code syntax and source graphs
skills.description: Python AST extraction records qualified classes/functions, imports and calls. Optional Tree-sitter parsing adds bounded syntax facts for other detected languages.

skills.label: Native parser fault containment
skills.description: Tree-sitter parsing runs in a reusable worker process; timeout/crash cases discard the worker and return classified failure receipts.

skills.label: Git history and per-parent change provenance
skills.description: Registered repository history includes reachable refs, commit/tree/object identities and per-parent change/hunk records, then binds a selected commit to a source graph for impact traversal.

skills.label: Versioned lane schemas and transactional migration
skills.description: Migration code checks exact lane/version and confirmation/replay identity, applies DDL and FTS changes under a savepoint, validates integrity/foreign keys, and preserves migration receipts.

skills.label: Hash-checked evidence retrieval
skills.description: Lane readers validate table names, return source/chunk locators, decompress content-addressed payloads and verify size/hash before exposing evidence.

skills.label: Lexical retrieval with explicit ranking mechanics
skills.description: FTS5 BM25 generates a bounded pool; query-time TF-IDF reranks that pool and reciprocal-rank fusion combines orders with k=60.

skills.label: Separate Project Memory retrieval
skills.description: Project Memory uses bounded FTS/BM25 locators with as-of selection, deduplication, stale active-task suppression and typed edges, while returning head/query hashes.

skills.label: Earlier implementation: Separate accepted AI Learning lifecycle
skills.description: Learning HIL binds candidates to project/pointer hashes; accepted-only retrieval checks freshness, source/scope and conflicts. Consolidated acceptance and Delta membership have explicit separate semantics.

skills.label: Typed task exchange with receiver-owned review
skills.description: Canon validates revision/lineage and idempotency, classifies envelopes into admissible or pending-HIL states, and binds review to the receiver task and packet hash.

skills.label: Task-relationship graph and bounded dispatch contract
skills.description: Canon rejects self/cyclic/conflicting task edges and requires write authority before linked-task dispatch through an injected host seam or caller-mediated exchange.

skills.label: Append-only plan state machine
skills.description: Plan events validate allowed status transitions, prevent conflicting idempotency-key reuse and hash-link global/per-task history. Correction transitions preserve the earlier event instead of erasing it.

skills.label: Plan projection and operational querying
skills.description: Canonical event state is materialized into a durable plan projection with separate status/query paths; schema and state validation accompany projection writes.

skills.label: Earlier implementation: Guarded candidate construction
skills.description: Candidate build checks session/pointer generation, source identity and acceptance checks, records code/task evidence and seals a review package without accepting it.

skills.label: Earlier implementation: Separate Learning and Project acceptance at the public Fuse boundary
skills.description: The earlier MCP Fuse route requires the consolidated Learning acceptance; service logic checks exact APPROVE, matching proposed PV and pointer before promotion.

skills.label: Earlier implementation: Content-addressed accepted snapshot packaging
skills.description: The reviewed earlier route builds and verifies a deduplicated archive from the live root, checks pointer/generation, writes a swap journal and verifies the new accepted archive before purging the prior archive.

skills.label: Earlier implementation: State Travel preserves exact work and candidate state

title: Evidence Lane | Governed Project-State Continuity for AI Workflows
headline: Preserve the state. Review the change.
description: The earlier Evidence Lane App explored a practical question: how can a local project retain its source material, proposed changes and accepted state when AI-assisted work evolves? It is the desktop prototype that preceded the current plugin system.
limits: Local Windows prototype. Candidate versus accepted states; source-linked records; portable SQLite snapshots. No production deployment claim.

chapters.title: The methods and tools behind this project.
chapters.body: The work combines business reasoning with practical methods and tools. Each capability here is tied to the project story you have just explored.

chapters.motion: The final scene opens a constellation of skills and real tool emblems.

skills.label: Single-product problem decomposition
skills.description: Scopes the study around one 1.55 oz chocolate product and separates ingredients, sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, logistics, retail and cost questions.

skills.label: A substantive batch data-processing backend
skills.description: Implements an ordered source-to-display pipeline through inventory, extraction, chunking, parsing, audit, domain packets, cost/graph construction, OCR/retrieval enrichment and public JSON export.

skills.label: Public-source inventory and source taxonomy
skills.description: Organizes 120 recorded inputs into 13 evidence packets, with document types, roles and source categories. The exact inventory contains 105 PDFs, 9 images, 2 CSVs and 4 Excel workbooks.

skills.label: Stable document identity and integrity fingerprints
skills.description: Assigns path-derived document IDs and SHA-256 fingerprints, retaining source filenames, source roles and extraction status for downstream tracing.

skills.label: Multiformat extraction and tabular normalization
skills.description: Uses PyMuPDF for page-delimited PDF text and selected page rendering, pandas for CSV/Excel sheets and previews, python-docx for documents and Pillow for image metadata.

skills.label: Selective OCR with confidence and image provenance
skills.description: Detects weak-text/visual documents, preprocesses images, runs Tesseract, captures word confidence, page/image hashes and source-linked OCR chunks. The recorded run attempted 197 pages/images with 196 successful OCR calls.

skills.label: Source-linked chunking and bounded context selection
skills.description: Builds overlapping 2,200-character text chunks with 300-character overlap and page/offset metadata, then selects opening and high-signal chunks under a context budget.

skills.label: Domain-specific deterministic information extraction
skills.description: Extracts companies, ingredients, process stages, prices, units, dates and candidate relationships into a structured document record.

skills.label: Typed evidence records with claim-to-source links
skills.description: Creates evidence IDs with source document/file, quoted text, claim role, relationship strength, confidence, display state, human-review flag and allowed wording.

skills.label: Explicit claim-scope and display rules
skills.description: Separates SKU evidence, company-level relationships, benchmarks, modeled routes, reference visuals and unknown claims, with staged audit and display decisions.

skills.label: Unified text and OCR corpus
skills.description: Merges text/table and OCR chunks while preserving source type, document IDs, original chunk IDs, offsets and signals. The recorded corpus has 2,303 chunks from 116 documents.

skills.label: Deduplication and rebuild accounting
skills.description: Uses stable content-derived keys to reduce repeated claim candidates and records input, retained, rejected and output counts. The captured enriched build records 1,020 candidates, 59 removed duplicates and 961 evidence records.

skills.label: Custom sparse TF-IDF retrieval implementation
skills.description: Computes term/document frequencies, inverse-document-frequency weights, normalized sparse vectors and an inverted index, then scores queries against source chunks.

skills.label: Retrieval test harness and question bundles
skills.description: Checks supplier, ingredient, SKU, price and cost retrieval cases using expected packets/terms and creates source-bearing question bundles for further evidence parsing.

skills.label: Supplier-context classification
skills.description: Builds four supplier/distribution packets with source IDs, confidence, restrictions and an explicit company-level versus exact-SKU distinction.

skills.label: Ingredient and material knowledge structure
skills.description: Links ingredient/material nodes to source packets, label/context status, supplier uncertainty and processing logic. The enriched output contains 12 cards covering ingredients plus packaging and product-label context.

skills.label: Transparent benchmark cost scenarios
skills.description: Implements low/base/high ingredient and operating-cost scenarios, unit conversion from dollars per pound and grams per bar, an assumptions register and evidence-linked cost records.

skills.label: Retail observation ingestion and unit checks
skills.description: Provides a contact-sheet/manual-entry workflow and validates retailer, price range, product size, pack size and verification status before using four recorded retailer observations.

skills.label: Correct separation of retail residual from profit
skills.description: Computes the difference between observed retail prices and modeled physical cost and labels the residual as a channel/commercial pool that can include margins, promotions, overhead and estimation error.

skills.label: Typed product-flow graph construction
skills.description: Builds 35 nodes and 36 edges across ingredients, packaging, process, logistics, finished goods and costs, retaining relationship status, confidence and evidence references.

skills.label: Independent backend outputs for frontend consumption
skills.description: Builds node-detail panels, source lookup dictionaries, supplier/material cards, cost displays and graph payloads, then rebuilds enriched versions without depending on a finished UI.

skills.label: Export boundary and payload validation
skills.description: Converts asset paths to public URLs, preserves collision handling, validates manifest/file presence, graph endpoints, evidence states, numeric cost fields and local-path leakage before frontend consumption.

skills.label: Typed artifact loader and visible loading/error states
skills.description: The Next.js client loads a manifest and seven JSON payloads, exposes typed cost/graph/evidence structures, and renders loading, error and summary states on the supply-chain route.

skills.label: Interactive visual explanation of the pipeline
skills.description: The homepage includes an interactive pipeline map and a product showcase with front/back/unwrapped states, hover inspection, automatic progression and manual selection.

skills.label: Implemented React Three Fiber scene work
skills.description: Uses Three.js, React Three Fiber and Drei to build procedural funnel paths, particle/mesh scenes, lights and a decorative background composition.

skills.label: Custom shader and video compositing
skills.description: Implements a WebGL video texture and GLSL chroma-key removal with green spill correction, color remapping, gloss, opacity and hero-layer composition.

skills.label: Responsive navigation and motion-aware interface controls
skills.description: Implements mobile navigation, route highlighting, skip-to-content and reduced-motion fallbacks using React/Framer Motion.

skills.label: Business-facing scope and uncertainty communication
skills.description: The code explicitly distinguishes public evidence from confidential company information, modeled costs/routes from observed facts and visual assets from evidence, while linking technical outputs to an operations question.
